title: Threats against Asberg and his family over the Baltic Sea anomaly

tellings.quote: Uh not really, but you know, you get mails and and like threatening me and my kids and and uh lots of things like that.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter, says his team found an odd object on the floor of the Baltic Sea in 2011, which people now call the Baltic Sea anomaly. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that since then he has received emails threatening him and his children. He tells it to show how heated things got around the find.
